query_or_task: Confirm the extension ID Chrome shows for the unpacked ProofLoop extension
outcome_or_error: The agent first flagged a 30-character ID as truncated, then accepted it as valid because the user said the options page loaded, and drafted a message using it. The ID was a mistyped copy: Chrome extension IDs are 32 letters (a-p), and the correct 32-character ID was supplied later.
constraint: A Chrome extension ID is exactly 32 letters a-p. Never accept another length or call an ID valid because a page loaded; ask for a fresh copy from the extensions page and check the length before using it.

query_or_task: Probe live Cognee Cloud ingest and search for the replay harness
outcome_or_error: The ingest call returned HTTP 200 and the client reported one item added, but search failed for minutes with a no-data error. The response showed an empty data_ids list: plain form fields are silently ignored, and only file uploads under the data field are stored. The client now uploads files and fails if nothing is stored.
constraint: A 200 response is not proof of storage. Require returned data IDs or a readback before reporting success, and fail loudly when nothing was stored.

query_or_task: Promote the v1.1 skill to Senso and verify it by readback
outcome_or_error: Promotion failed at the readback step on every replay although the upload succeeded. The readback searched by a title shared with earlier uploads, so the new item was not in the top results. A direct call with a different title passed. Titles now include the cycle ID and a timestamp.
constraint: A readback must identify the exact uploaded item, by unique title or content ID, not by a title shared with earlier uploads.

query_or_task: Find why the local gateway reports missing Cloudflare credentials
outcome_or_error: The gateway said the Cloudflare account and token were missing, but both existed in the env files under a misspelled prefix (CLOUDFARE_). The agent listed variable names only, mapped them for the gateway process, then renamed them with approval and deleted the temporary backups that held copies of the secrets.
constraint: When a service reports missing credentials, check for misspelled variable names before concluding the key is absent. List names only, never print values, and delete any backup that contains secrets.
